newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Ericsson says wins $54 million Russia order.
newsitem.headline: Ericsson says wins $54 million Russia order.

text.p: Swedish telecoms group Ericsson said on Wednesday it had won a $54 million D-AMPS order from Vimpelcom, a wireless communications operator in Moscow.
"This is the largest order ever for any D-AMPS/AMPS cellular system in Russia, and it is the seventh expansion of the network," Ericsson said in a statement.
The order is for the supply and installation of additional RBS 884 radio base stations and mobile AXE 10 switches, Ericsson said, adding that the first deliveries were scheduled for August.
Vimpelcom, which sells its services under the Bee-Line trademark, is the biggest cellular operator in Russia and (CIS) with more than 65,000 subscribers in its Moscow network.
